source.name: Score and Change, Overview of the 2026/2027 Premier League sponsors
source.quote: This was upgraded to a front-of-shirt partnership for the men’s, women’s and academy teams before the start of the 2024/25 season. The current deal runs until at least 2029

source.name: Manchester United – 'SumUp becomes United's Official Sleeve Partner'
source.quote: will see the SumUp logo feature on the sleeve of the playing shirt for the men’s, women’s and Academy teams across all competitions

source.name: Manchester United, Microsoft Surface to feature on United shirts
source.quote: Surface branding will also appear on United shirts in men’s first team domestic cup competitions throughout the 2026/27 season.
source.note: Back-of-shirt coverage is selective for the men's first team: pre-season fixtures plus domestic cup competitions in 2026/27 (Score and Change: 'Microsoft Surface now featuring on the back of match day shirts during selective fixtures (e.g. domestic cup matches)').

source.name: Manchester United – 'Betway announced as Official Principal Partner'
source.quote: Through the new agreement, the Betway logo will feature on the training kits of Manchester United’s men’s and women’s teams.
source.note: Betway is Official Principal Partner and Exclusive Global Betting Partner; on the playing-shirt lineup its placement is the training kit, not the match shirt.

summary: Snapdragon (front, to at least 2029), SumUp (sleeve, from September 2026), Microsoft Surface on the back for pre-season and cup fixtures, Betway on the training kit; adidas is the kit maker (Premier League kit records list shirt sponsors only).
